summary: The Iceberg Community Sync notes for 16 September 2026 cover highlights, releases and four discussion items. Highlights included a virtual meetup series, Java merges for read restrictions in loadTable, Spark 4.2.0 support, REST catalog labels and V4 work, plus Python, Rust, Go and C++ changes. PyIceberg 0.12 and the Terraform provider v0.1.0 were marked as released, with Java 1.12 in progress and Rust 0.11 RC2 under vote. In discussion, Ryan raised best practices for handling LLM contributions, with Kevin and Martin proposing updates to the contribution guide and the agents file. Martin listed the Vortex file format proposal, Daehong presented reducing per-row position delete index probes in vectorized reads, which needs a new API, and Neelesh gave an update on the shared testing repository.

topics.title: Highlights across implementations
topics.summary: The notes open with the Apache Iceberg Virtual Meetup Series and its dev list thread. Java highlights: finer grained read restrictions as part of loadTable in the spec, Spark 4.2.0 support, a labels field in the REST spec for catalog metadata enrichment, eager fetch in the Parquet read path, and a set of V4 pull requests. Python: REST retry and timeout configuration, the start of encryption support, expanded view support, fast_forward_branch, an equality_ids manifest schema fix and a merge queue. Rust: deletion vector read, write and validation support, a PositionDeleteFileWriter, and removal of the DataFusion TableProvider export from pyiceberg-core. Go and C++ changes are also listed.

topics.title: Releases
topics.summary: The release list shows Java 1.12 in progress and Rust 0.11 RC2 with a vote thread. PyIceberg 0.12 and the Apache Iceberg Terraform Provider v0.1.0 are marked as done.

topics.title: Best practices for handling LLM contributions
topics.summary: Ryan raised best practices for handling LLM contributions. Kevin pointed to a blog post whose framing of pull requests and contributions he likes, and proposed possible action items: update the contribution page for humans with best practices for contributing to open source, perhaps update the guidelines for AI-assisted contributions, and update agents.md for agents. Martin noted the current file has a PR and commit conventions section but no pre-PR checklist, and suggested spelling out best practices such as checking for related pull requests first with specific commands, since positive examples tend to help. A problem noted is that the onus is on the reviewer to determine whether the AI is correct.
open_questions: Which of the proposed updates (contribution page, AI-assisted contribution guidelines, agents.md) should be made?
How to reduce the burden on reviewers of determining whether AI-produced changes are correct?

topics.title: Proposal: adding Vortex as an Iceberg file format
topics.summary: Martin listed the proposal to add Vortex as an Iceberg file format, with its design document. The notes record no discussion or outcome.

topics.title: Reducing per-row position delete index probes in the vectorized read path
topics.summary: Daehong explained that vectorized reads probe the position delete index once per row, although the positions in a batch are a contiguous ascending range, so the index can be traversed once instead. The gain is significant when few columns are projected and not visible end to end on wide projections, where the delete check is a small share of scan CPU. The change needs a new API, PositionDeleteIndex.forEachInRange, and he asked whether the community is fine with that. The notes record no answer.
open_questions: Is the community OK with adding the new PositionDeleteIndex.forEachInRange API?

topics.title: Iceberg-verification (shared testing repo) update
topics.summary: Neelesh listed an update on iceberg-verification, the shared testing repository. The notes record no details.
